tlog.msg: Light: DAWN.

CHAPTER E.2 — CLAWS OUT (NORMAL). A crab, dark red, approximately the size of a church, is wading ashore toward the village of HIKE from grid 227 580. It is a MOVING TARGET — lead it. It is also a crab. The village is NO-STRIKE as always. Stop it before landfall; nobody will discuss this afterwards.
Par time for full stars: 7:00.
MET: wind from 1300 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 554, ground elev 262 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "DERBY" grid 254 561 (grid brg 0960) · AB1002 "ICEBOX" grid 239 573 (grid brg 6072). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages HIKE and MOVA and FAVANGO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.

>>> THE JOB: A crab, dark red, approximately the size of a church, is wading ashore toward the village of HIKE from grid 227 580. It is a MOVING TARGET — lead it. It is also a crab. The village is NO-STRIKE as always. Stop it before landfall; nobody will discuss this afterwards.
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.
MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND — nobody has sent us a thing. No patrol report, no overlay, no cue. Start glassing and tell me what is out there, over.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: It is a MOVING TARGET, killer. Lead it like the convoy: fire where it is GOING to be, not where it makes you feel things.
HELLHOUND FIRES, THIS IS MUSTANG 12, ADJUST FIRE, GRID 227580, HARD STRUCTURE MOBILE, FUZE DELAY, OVER
hellhound fires, this is mustang 12, adjust fire, grid 227580, hard structure mobile, fuze delay, over
SHEAF: CONVERGED (inferred) — small hard target — every piece on the same point.
FUZE: DELAY (requested) — FUZE DELAY requested in the call.

MESSAGE TO OBSERVER: ONE GUN IN ADJUST, BATTERY IN EFFECT, 1 ROUND, 155 HE, FUZE DELAY, TARGET NUMBER ALPHA ALPHA 7001, OVER.
Solid copy. Somewhere a dead artillery instructor just felt a warm, deeply confused sense of pride.
